scope: Shared All number parser and comparisons, GUI scientific rounding/error preservation, native CLI percentage and numeric flags, Lua explicit upper values and exact restoration through BE32 and real ARM64 QEMU RAM. Independent data-path checks, not broader Linux ISA debugging coverage.
newModelChecks: All numeric literals preserve fractional and negative integer comparison boundaries in both byte orders
All numeric literals accept scientific/hex/comma forms and retain exponent-adjusted decimal precision
All numeric literals retain exact signed 64-bit boundaries independently of double rounding
All delta literals reject fractional integer changes and preserve the complete unsigned distance across signed endpoints
All infinity searches and unknown nonfinite candidates never invent integer zero matches
All floating relational bounds retain double input precision rather than rounding to the candidate's width
All percentage comparisons use their own thresholds without requiring unrelated numeric search values
Malformed All numeric literals and missing upper bounds fail atomically rather than scanning zero or a prefix
Decimal and scientific All boundaries agree with 51102 independent exact rational integer comparisons
Lua All scans use strict numeric boundaries, explicit Between upper values and preserve results on malformed input
